messages:
clare (finance): FYI: on 2027-01-12 we're changing the overage notification cadence and adding an "overage_advisory" column to exports. Dry-run (telemetry-only) starts 2026-12-01.

dan (product): TL;DR for customers: we will send earlier advisory notices before an overage invoice posts and include an advisory field in CSVs so automations can surface it. No billing change during dry-run.

ivana (eng-billing): Dev notes: feature flag: overage_advisory_v1. New header X-Redwood-Overage-Advisory: true|dry-run. CSV adds overage_advisory column (string). We'll emit both old and new exports during December.

matt (support): CS: prepare short script: "You may receive advisory notices about potential overage events during Dec; these are informational and won't change billing until Jan 12." Add triage checklist: check X-Redwood-Overage-Advisory header, review export column, escalate if customers see unexpected billed amounts.

notify-bot: scheduled announcement draft created for week of 2026-11-29 owner=product :white_check_mark:

clare (finance): Owners: finance (clare) - notices & CSV mapping; eng (ivana) - feature flag & headers; product (dan) - customer comms; support (matt) - canned replies. Please update the playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/overage-notices (internal).
